title: The SRS compass is advanced and all spec decisions go through it; should every project have its equivalent? (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Now, our SRS compass is pretty advanced and and all spec decisions still go through it.


Should we look at the equivalent across all projects? The fractal version is the current attempt to get domain and working group axes

sections.label: Source
